source: Overall, basketball games yielded higher Diva Scores than other sporting events and political events.
claim: Basketball performances average 294.4 in overall Diva Score, the highest of the six event types, ahead of football (276.9), political events (272.0), baseball (236.6), racing (200.3) and hockey (192.4).

source: Average Diva Scores by music genre match intuition, with R&B and pop divas adding more flourishes than country or rock divas.
claim: R&B performances average 322.5 and pop 252.6 in overall Diva Score, above country (204.2) and rock (178.1).

source: Two words: Aretha Franklin. The “Queen of Soul” shows out on this phrase, and she’s in good company: 8 of the top 10 Diva Scores for this phrase are from fellow R&B artists.
claim: In the phrase where Aretha Franklin has the highest Diva Score (766.3), 8 of the top 10 scores are by R&B artists.

source: Case in point: Jazmine Sullivan rarely has a top 3 Diva Score (although she ranks as the #17 overall diva), but we think she consistently sings some of the most beautiful and creative vocal runs.
claim: Jazmine Sullivan ranks 17th overall with an overall Diva Score of 370.4, and her best phrase Diva Score ranks 9th.
code: ids[ids.eventType != 'standard'].assign(overall_rank=lambda d: d.overall_diva.rank(ascending=False), best_phrase_rank=lambda d: d[[f'phrase{p}_diva' for p in range(16)]].rank(ascending=False).min(axis=1))[lambda d: d['id'].str.startswith('jazmine')][['overall_diva','overall_rank','best_phrase_rank']].T

source: She has the highest average Diva Score per phrase, making her our #1 Diva.
claim: Chaka Khan's average phrase Diva Score is 734.3, the highest of all performances.

source: There are 7 performers in our dataset who have performed the National Anthem 3 or more times.
claim: Seven artists have at least three performances: Billy Joel (4), Carrie Underwood (4), Jordin Sparks (4), Demi Lovato (3), Jewel (3), Kelly Clarkson (3) and Mary J. Blige (3).

source: Mary J. Blige, in particular, holds down two of the top 10 Diva Score spots for this phrase: her performances at the 2009 World Series and 2012 NBA All-Star Game.
claim: Mary J. Blige's 2009 World Series and 2012 NBA All-Star performances rank 2nd (1304.4) and 8th (691.4) among the top 10 Diva Scores for the phrase.

source: Two inauguration performances, where “flag” is emphasized, rise to the top for this phrase: Beyoncé (2013) and Lady Gaga (2021).
claim: Lady Gaga's 2021 inauguration performance has the phrase's top Diva Score (2173.0), followed by Beyoncé's 2013 inauguration (2016.5).

source: Trace Adkins sings in the lowest key among our dataset (D); Jennifer Hudson (and others) are in the highest (A)
claim: Trace Adkins's D is the lowest key in the dataset (steps_from_C -10), while Jennifer Hudson's A is the highest (9).

source: Most performers don’t really get going until the last half of the song so these first few phrases are comparatively tame.
claim: The last eight phrases average 352.6 in Diva Score, more than twice the 155.2 average of the first eight.
code: ids[ids.eventType != 'standard'][[f'phrase{p}_diva' for p in range(16)]].mean().groupby(lambda c: 'first 8' if int(c[len('phrase'):].split('_')[0]) < 8 else 'last 8').mean().round(1)

source: For slightly more mellow, but still noteworthy performances, check out H.E.R. at the 2023 World Series and Taylor Swift at the 2008 World Series, T-Swift's highest recorded Diva Score for a phrase.
claim: Taylor Swift's highest phrase Diva Score is 353.5 at the 2008 World Series, above her 2006 maximum of 308.2.

Average Diva Scores by phrase, highest first: phrase 15 601.7, phrase 14 403.3, phrase 11 399.0, phrase 12 360.8, phrase 13 346.7, phrase 2 271.3, phrase 9 245.7, phrase 10 239.3, phrase 8 224.5, phrase 6 212.9, phrase 5 149.8, phrase 7 135.5, phrase 3 132.2, phrase 1 130.8, phrase 4 112.1 and phrase 0 96.9.

source: The true divas shine for the anthem’s closing phrase.
claim: The closing phrase (phrase 15) has the highest average Diva Score at 601.7, ahead of phrase 14 at 403.3.

source: But Anthony Hamilton — he’s basically singing a different melody at the 2019 NBA All-Star Game.
claim: Anthony Hamilton's 2019 NBA All-Star performance has the highest Diva Score on the phrase (529.4), ahead of Chris Stapleton (353.3) and Lauren Alaina (309.6).

source: Towards the end of the anthem, you’re not making the top diva list unless you have a well-deserved royalty nickname: “The Queen of Funk” Chaka Khan, “Queen of Hip-Hop Soul” Mary J. Blige, and the “Godmother of Soul” Patti Labelle.
claim: Chaka Khan (2034.3), Mary J. Blige (1304.4) and Patti Labelle (1289.2) have the phrase's top three Diva Scores.
